scope: CVG-002B2a durable synthetic PIX attempt and dispatcher core

criteria.description: The B2a durable-attempt/dispatcher boundary, B2b callback/worker boundary, B2c SPA/E2E boundary and external homologation boundary are explicit and non-overlapping.
criteria.limitations: Only local provider-neutral attempt persistence, a disposable synthetic dispatcher, canonical read API and their tests are authorized; callback, settlement worker, full SPA, Pagar.me and production are excluded.

criteria.description: The state machine, exact-cents model, idempotency keys, claim/lease/fencing rules, transaction boundaries and failure/restart observations are executable without network inside PostgreSQL transactions.
criteria.limitations: Generic outbox lease evidence is reusable architecture evidence only; B2a must still add PIX-specific rejecting tests for every accepted claim, external-call and fenced persistence guarantee.

criteria.description: The RED-first files, negative/security cases, regression surface, coverage target, review loop and human/external exclusions are concrete enough to start the smallest coherent implementation.
criteria.limitations: Implementation readiness grants no behavioral, callback, browser, homologation or release PASS; fresh PostgreSQL/RLS, restart, API/worker regression, coverage, security and independent review evidence remains mandatory.

authority.scope: CVG-002B2a durable synthetic PIX attempt and dispatcher core
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation, disposable PostgreSQL and an explicitly non-production synthetic provider for the bounded durable PIX attempt/dispatcher core; callback, real providers, credentials, external mutation, production and release remain excluded.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before callback work, worker settlement, real provider/sandbox/credentials, external mutation, production, migration deployment or release acceptance.
